title: Space dependency DAG — canonical allowed-edge config (AD1)
description: Machine-readable authority for which repo may depend on which inside the Alembic space. Encodes the P0 fact-freeze §2 DAG verified against live package manifests on 2026-06-12: Core ← Agent ← Alembic; Core ← Plugin; Dashboard zero-package-dependency. Every repo's boundary gate consumes this config READ-ONLY and verifies its OWN edges; AlembicCore's gate is scripts/check-space-edges.mjs. Edge changes require a controller decision recorded here plus the affected repos' gates updated in the same wave.

consumerContract.access: Consumer repos read this file READ-ONLY through their existing Core link (node_modules/@alembic/core/config/space-allowed-edges.json via the file: dependency) or the sibling checkout path; they never copy or fork it.
consumerContract.perRepoDuty: Each repo's gate asserts exactly its own entry: its package manifest's space dependencies equal allowedDependencies, and (where the repo has source-level import gates) no space-package import escapes that set. Cross-repo verification belongs to the owning repo's gate, never to another repo's.

stages.alembicCore: this stage (pA1): scripts/check-space-edges.mjs wired into npm run check
stages.alembic: P2 consumer stage: edge assertion gate rides the existing check pipeline
stages.alembicAgent: P2 consumer stage: edge assertion gate rides the existing check pipeline
stages.alembicDashboard: P2 consumer stage: zero-package-dependency gate (closes the P0 §2 'no Dashboard zero-dep gate' hole)
stages.alembicPlugin: owner+trigger record only until CKG resumption — owner: AlembicPlugin window; trigger: P3 step 2 (IC5) / CKG resumption package; the vendored Core snapshot remains a distribution artifact, not a dependency edge

alembicCore.charter: knowledge/search/graph/guard/vector/evolution engine + persistence + migrations + shared taxonomy/errors; importable leaf core/ analysis. Must-never: host/UI/transport specifics.

alembicAgent.charter: LLM provider/tool runtime (V2 catalog, transports, classification). Must-never: knowledge persistence; HTTP surface.

alembic.charter: resident MCP + HTTP + daemon + CLI host over Core; owns routes, injection, sandbox, UI. Must-never: re-implement Core engine capabilities; direct DB schema ownership.

alembicDashboard.charter: zero-dependency UI consumer of the HTTP contract via generated types. Must-never: @alembic package imports; business logic beyond projection.

alembicPlugin.gateParticipation: post-CKG (owner: AlembicPlugin window; trigger: CKG resumption / P3 IC5)
alembicPlugin.charter: Codex/Claude-Code host shells + plugin MCP surface + vendored Core runtime + distribution packaging. Must-never: fork Core semantics; main-repo route duplication beyond the declared overlay.

charterRefs.source: P0 unified fact freeze §7 charter DRAFTS (wakeflow-ledger/requirement-designs/alembic-portfolio-execution-plan/p0-unified-fact-freeze-2026-06-12.md)
charterRefs.status: drafts — confirmed at AD2; the charter strings above are projections of those drafts, not yet user-confirmed charters

exactEdgeAllowlistContract: Each entry requires {repo, dependency, owner, reason, cleanupTrigger}; entries without all five fields fail the gate. Empty today — the verified DAG needs no exceptions.

toolchainFloor.description: Space toolchain floor derived from CURRENT repo facts (engines fields + pinned/installed gate tooling) — floors record what is already true, never aspirations. Drift note rule: raising or lowering any floor requires a wakeflow-ledger note naming the wave that re-measured it; gates fail below floor with an explicit message.

facts.engines.node: >=22.0.0 in Core/Alembic/Agent/Plugin manifests (Dashboard has no engines field)
facts.typescript: Core devDependencies ^5.9.3; tsc 5.9.3 runs the build gates
